evidence.excerpt: SECURE-ICS addresses the growing need for robust cybersecurity monitoring in industrial manufacturing environments. The project develops an integrated security monitoring platform tailored specifically to factory automation systems, encompassing network traffic analysis, anomaly detection, and real-time alerting for operational technology networks. As academic partner, the University of Novi Sad team led by Professor Đukić contributes expertise in intrusion detection algorithm design, threat modelling for ICS environments, and evaluation methodology. The platform targets Modbus, PROFINET, and EtherNet/IP protocol stacks commonly found in Serbian manufacturing facilities. Deliverables include a deployable monitoring agent, a validated anomaly detection model trained on representative factory traffic, and a set of security assessment guidelines for small and medium enterprises in the industrial sector. The project runs from 2023 to 2025 under the Innovation Fund programme.
